- `target_path` (string) - Optional download destination; the Packer cache is used by default.

- `vm_name` (string) - Name of the UTM virtual machine.

- `cpus` (int) - CPUs assigned to the guest; defaults to 4.

- `memory` (int) - Guest memory in MiB; defaults to 8192.

- `install_timeout` (duration string | ex: "1h5m2s") - Maximum duration of the macOS restore; defaults to 90 minutes.

- `keep_registered` (bool) - Keep the VM registered in UTM after a successful export.

- `macos_auto_login` (bool) - Enable automatic login during first-boot provisioning (macOS 27+).
